text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Rudolf invites me to<n>sit in on her
dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today. Did anything<n>strike you as
requiring attention?

Symboli Rudolf's routine was so<n>flawless, I can't
think of anything to<n>bring up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
May I assume from your silence that<n>my
performance was acceptable?
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I can't be more helpful.
I'm sorry I can't be more helpful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. If nothing stands out to the<n>untrained
eye, then I have achieved<n>the bare minimum at
least.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll devote a little more attention to<n>this song,
however, as it still has<n>room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside, there is something<n>else I was
hoping to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have been looking to broaden my<n>range by
exploring new dance styles,<n>but I am uncertain
where to begin.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you have any ideas, please, don't<n>hold back.
choice_data_list: How do you feel about breakdancing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. Cutesy, you say...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That would certainly be out of the<n>norm for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present.<n>First, you
must tell me exactly what<n>you consider "cutesy."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So I must smile, wink, and standpigeon-toed? Haha, there's more tothis than I previously appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that won't stop me from rising to<n>the
challenge.

With that, Symboli Rudolf throws<n>herself into
practicing all kinds of<n>cutesy routines.

She seems satisfied that the effort<n>has broadened
her horizons.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Breakdancing? That would certainly<n>be a new
frontier...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's unlike anything I've attempted<n>before, but
with it does come a certain<n>freshness and
freedom of<n>expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I could incorporate it into my routine,<n>I think I
would improve dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present.<n>I should get
started.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can rely on your assistance, I hope?

And so Symboli Rudolf's horizons<n>expand once
more, driven by an<n>insatiable hunger for
self-improvement.
